scoped_dependencies.relation: The circuit construction evaluates the same exact Pauli/Choi coefficient family; source-reported scoped dependence only.

failure: Failure: These are source-derived complexity claims with no new class separation. They concern exact positivity/evaluation from the succinct circuit description; they do not establish hardness of fixed-time additive approximation or physical acquisition costs. The report says the rational recovery is polynomial-size but the reduction has not been independently checked.
interface: Interface: A Boolean circuit is supplied that maps uniform random bits to a Pauli label; the channel is represented by this sampler rather than its exponentially large probability table.

claims.title: Succinct Pauli input makes positivity a surjectivity problem and exact evaluation counting-hard
